name: Build APK - ONLINE HYBRID FIXED

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Create project
        run: |
          rm -rf app
          mkdir -p app/src/main/java/com/hkbus/allinone app/src/main/res/values app/src/main/assets

          cat > settings.gradle <<'EOF'
          pluginManagement {
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
                  gradlePluginPortal()
              }
          }
          dependencyResolutionManagement {
              repositoriesMode.set(RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS)
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
              }
          }
          include ':app'
          EOF

          cat > build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins {
              id 'com.android.application' version '8.2.2' apply false
          }
          EOF

          cat > gradle.properties <<'EOF'
          org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m
          android.useAndroidX=true
          EOF

          cat > app/build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins {
              id 'com.android.application'
          }
          android {
              namespace 'com.hkbus.allinone'
              compileSdk 34
              defaultConfig {
                  applicationId "com.hkbus.allinone"
                  minSdk 24
                  targetSdk 34
                  versionCode 20
                  versionName "4.2-online-fixed"
              }
          }
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml <<'EOF'
          <resources><string name="app_name">全港交通</string></resources>
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml <<'EOF'
          <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION"/>
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION"/>
            <application android:label="@string/app_name" android:theme="@android:style/Theme.NoTitleBar" android:hardwareAccelerated="true" android:usesCleartextTraffic="true">
              <activity android:name=".MainActivity" android:exported="true"><intent-filter><action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/><category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/></intent-filter></activity>
            </application>
          </manifest>
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/assets/index.html <<'HTML'
          <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>離線保底</title><style>body{font-family:sans-serif;background:#f5f5f7;padding:40px 20px;text-align:center}</style></head><body><h2>📡 載入線上版失敗，已切換離線版</h2><p>請檢查 Vercel / GitHub Pages 是否已修復</p></body></html>
          HTML

          cat > app/src/main/java/com/hkbus/allinone/MainActivity.java <<'EOF'
          package com.hkbus.allinone;
          import android.app.Activity; import android.os.Bundle; import android.webkit.*; import android.widget.Toast;
          public class MainActivity extends Activity {
              WebView wv; boolean fallbackDone=false;
              final String PRIMARY_URL="https://hketaapp.vercel.app";
              final String SECONDARY_URL="https://benyeung08.github.io/hketaapp/";
              final String OFFLINE_URL="file:///android_asset/index.html";
              protected void onCreate(Bundle b){
                  super.onCreate(b);
                  wv=new WebView(this);
                  wv.getSettings().setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
                  wv.getSettings().setDomStorageEnabled(true);
                  wv.getSettings().setGeolocationEnabled(true);
                  wv.getSettings().setMixedContentMode(WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW);
                  wv.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient(){ public void onGeolocationPermissionsShowPrompt(String o, GeolocationPermissions.Callback c){c.invoke(o,true,false);} });
                  wv.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient(){
                      public void onReceivedError(WebView view, WebResourceRequest req, WebResourceError err){ if(req.isForMainFrame() && !fallbackDone){ if(view.getUrl()!=null && view.getUrl().contains("vercel.app")){ view.loadUrl(SECONDARY_URL);} else { fallbackDone=true; Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this,"線上連線失敗，切換離線版",Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); view.loadUrl(OFFLINE_URL);} } }
                      public void onReceivedHttpError(WebView view, WebResourceRequest req, WebResourceResponse resp){ if(req.isForMainFrame() && resp.getStatusCode()==404 && !fallbackDone){ if(view.getUrl()!=null && view.getUrl().contains("vercel.app")){ view.loadUrl(SECONDARY_URL);} else if(view.getUrl()!=null && view.getUrl().contains("github.io")){ fallbackDone=true; Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this,"Vercel+GitHub 404，切換離線",Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); view.loadUrl(OFFLINE_URL);} } }
                  });
                  wv.loadUrl(PRIMARY_URL);
                  setContentView(wv);
              }
              public void onBackPressed(){ if(wv.canGoBack()) wv.goBack(); else super.onBackPressed(); }
          }
          EOF

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with: { distribution: 'temurin', java-version: '17' }
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with: { gradle-version: '8.5', cache-disabled: true }
      - name: Install SDK
        run: |
          yes | $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true
          $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"
      - name: Build APK
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace 2>&1 | tee build.log
      - name: Upload result always
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: build-result-online
          path: |
            build.log
            app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
